purpose: Original 3D city ruler honor medals in Sengoku VS
commonPrompt: One exquisite collectible city honor medal. High-end physically rendered 3D game UI inventory icon, sculpted metal bas-relief, polished antique gold with subtly worn beveled edges, colored translucent enamel, crisp studio highlights and dimensional depth. One centered complete mostly circular medal on a square canvas, with a few dignified decorative tips and no chains or ribbon tails. Straight-on view with slight relief perspective, light from upper left, a strong central motif readable at 32px. Genuinely transparent background, clean alpha edge, no ground plane, outside shadow, lettering, numbers, wordmarks, real insignia or watermark. Original fictional in-game honor.
processing: Alpha-preserving technical downscale to 384 × 384 and WebP encoding quality 92; no alteration of the generated illustration.

assets.subject: Edo Castle: an imposing ivory Japanese castle keep in miniature relief over deep indigo enamel, with a small curved bridge and two sweeping gold waves; strong dignified tiered tower silhouette.

Kyoto Imperial Palace: an original graceful golden phoenix with broad wings rising above a miniature vermilion palace roof, purple amethyst enamel center; elegant ceremonial silhouette; no real imperial seal.
Nijo Palace: an original miniature ornate black-and-gold karamon palace gate, jade-green enamel center, two subtle golden pine branches; clear architectural gate silhouette.
Osaka Castle: a miniature ivory-and-gold Japanese castle tower over rich vermilion enamel, flanked by two abstract golden tiger-like protective flourishes, bold radiant silhouette.

Nagoya Castle: two sculptural golden shachihoko dolphin-like tiger-headed roof ornaments facing one another above a small emerald-roofed Japanese castle, deep teal enamel center, iconic high-curved fish silhouettes.
